title: perf(nodes): load only what a worker turn needs

commit.messageHeadline: perf(nodes): split sealed worker bundles and defer turn imports
fix(nodes): update moved session context type imports
test(nodes): exercise the split worker artifact layout
test(nodes): distinguish built-ins from bundled packages
fix(nodes): keep maintenance contracts outside runtime readers
test(build): include worker inputs in declaration fixtures
fix(browser): keep tracked tab cleanup lazy

The inspected changes reorganize persisted-state code without changing a stored-data contract. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Distinct current-main behavior:** Current main still starts runtime imports when the admission request is sent; the PR moves turn-runtime loading after admission. ([`src/worker/worker.runtime.ts:161`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/b95394a915305f50c10e026276b81b91b92cb040/src/worker/worker.runtime.ts#L161), [b95394a91530](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b95394a915305f50c10e026276b81b91b92cb040)) - **Introduced worker boundary:** The reviewed head loads embedded-agent and inference-stream modules through one settled loader after connection admission. ([`src/worker/worker.runtime.ts:108`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/992d7f37fdda23ceb60c26fbb4f247a26067bc4e/src/worker/worker.runtime.ts#L108), [992d7f37fdda](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/992d7f37fdda23ceb60c26fbb4f247a26067bc4e)) - **Sealed chunk packaging:** The bundle producer stages generated worker chunks with the named entries, then hashes each staged artifact; a focused test covers archive relocation and changed-chunk hashes. ([`src/cli/update-cli/update-command-managed-context.ts:33`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/992d7f37fdda23ceb60c26fbb4f247a26067bc4e/src/cli/update-cli/update-command-managed-context.ts#L33), [992d7f37fdda](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/992d7f37fdda23ceb60c26fbb4f247a26067bc4e)) - **Repository upgrade policy:** The applicable policy requires a published installed updater against the candidate when update, Doctor, service lifecycle, migration, or plugin loading changes. Follow-up from the native landing of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/156307:

The complete remote build passed (408.2s), as did production, scripts and root-test type checks, but core lint failed on two current-main files:

- `src/gateway/worker-environments/bootstrap.ts`: `eslint(max-lines)`, 702 against 700.
- `src/gateway/worker-environments/bootstrap.test.ts`: `eslint(max-lines)`, 1023 against 1000.

Remote run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37074972322 . It ended exit 1; full tests were not reached, no native gate stamp was produced, and the owned remote lease is completed.

Both files and lint configuration are unchanged between the waveform candidate and its main base `456178d8da6439cc186b600eb4731fa4bff6ab08`. Live main `9ed025c44ddef2eff8916ba8711ad125d894a900` still has the exact failing blobs (`359657f11e8e8f0585c8b6933ee2350e4ef21363` and `aab1a0fa05a436338ac9062d67d6a1ce4a984efb`, respectively). Their latest path-changing commit is this PR's landed `4aa24e3a1340cf17e0d661e87d35d7789948d76f`.

@steipete could the existing worker-bootstrap owner take the scoped line-cap repair? No limit/baseline relaxation is requested. The portfolio is retaining completed scoped proof and holding further full-gate attempts against these known failing inputs rather than opening a duplicate known-main test/CI PR.
